claude.sample_unit: pressure injury images (training/test; 159 external validation images)

links.outcome: Accuracy on retained predictions and share of errors captured when low-confidence cases are deferred
links.effect: At 85% confidence threshold, accuracy on retained predictions reached 90.8% (vs 74.4% overall), while deferral captured 83.3% of all baseline errors; externally, retained accuracy was 72.7%.
links.quote: At an 85% confidence threshold, classification accuracy on retained predictions reached 90.8%, while deferral captured 83.3% of all baseline errors.

links.outcome: Performance drop on independent external dataset versus internal test
links.effect: External validation yielded macro-AUC-ROC of 0.809 and macro F1 score of 0.590, versus internal macro-AUC-ROC of 0.929; retained accuracy at 85% threshold was 72.7%.
links.quote: External validation yielded macro-AUC-ROC of 0.809 and macro F1 score of 0.590.

unlisted_practices: post-hoc temperature scaling to calibrate model confidence
LLM-generated structured wound documentation from NPIAP definitions

screen.practice: selective prediction deferral threshold and confidence calibration
screen.reason: The study develops and explicitly tests a selective classification safeguard (confidence calibration and threshold-based deferral of uncertain cases to clinician review) alongside automated clinical documentation, measuring error reduction when uncertain cases are deferred.
